name: duckduckgo
title: DuckDuckGo search
description: Web search without an API key through DuckDuckGo's HTML endpoint: title, URL and snippet of each result, optionally for a region. Only https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/ is requested. Needs network: Allowlist with html.duckduckgo.com:443.
notes: DuckDuckGo rate-limits automated queries; a refused query answers with an error naming that. Results are what DuckDuckGo shows, without ads.
